subject: POC kickoff — hands-on workshop, redaction & load test plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sam Bryant <sam.bryant@bridgetech.com>, Kiran Desai <kiran.desai@bridgetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff — hands-on workshop, redaction & load test plan

Hi Sam / Kiran,

Great to kick this off — thanks for the quick intro call earlier. We'd like to lock a 90-minute hands-on kickoff where we'll:
- walk through your representative prompts and routing rules,
- run a light load test (sanity + incremental ramp), and
- do a short prompt review / evaluation set run to baseline quality.

Proposed windows next week (pick one):
- Tue 2026-08-05 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 2026-08-06 13:00–14:30 PT

Pre-reqs from your side: please share a small representative sample (up to ~5k rows) of production-like payloads in JSONL or CSV. Important notes:
- Remove or mask any direct PII; if you prefer, hash user identifiers (we can validate format).
- Include a short eval prompt set (~20 prompts) and expected outputs where available.

For the load test: our plan is to start with a sanity run (~200 rps peak short burst), then ramp over 30 minutes toward your target (tell us expected concurrency/typical burst patterns). If you have a target throughput (requests/hour or peak concurrent users), include that in the upload.

You can upload to the Drive folder I’ve shared (link below) or to an S3 presigned location — whichever is easier. I’ve attached a short redaction checklist and a sample payload template to make this painless.

Attachments: redaction_guidelines.md (redaction checklist)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExample
Deal: HS-Deal-4892

If one of the two slots above works for you, confirm and we'll send an invite with a working session agenda.

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Sam Bryant <sam.bryant@bridgetech.com>

Date: 2026-08-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on workshop, redaction & load test plan

Hey Monica,

Thanks — both slots look doable on our side. Prefer Wed 2026-08-06 13:00 PT (we have product hours in the morning).

Quick clarifications on the payloads:
- We can provide JSONL with the following fields: user_id, prompt_text, session_id, geo, channel. Is hashing user_id okay? We can also strip email/phone fields.
- For eval prompts we have a set of ~25 labeled examples (expected vs. actual) we can include.

For load targets, our initial ask is to validate 5k requests/hour with short bursts up to 200 rps — long-term target is ~30k req/hour but that’s phase 2.

I’ve attached a small sample extract (first 200 rows) so you can sanity-check format. Will upload the full set to the Drive by EOD Monday (2026-08-03).

Attachment: sample_payload_examples.jsonl (preview, 200 rows)

Sam
Engineering Lead, BridgeTech

Perfect — Wed 2026-08-06 13:00 PT is confirmed. I just sent a calendar invite with a working agenda (90 mins).

Next steps for the file drop:
- Please upload the full JSONL to the Drive folder linked below (or share an S3 presigned link).
- File naming convention: bridge_sample_v1.jsonl and eval_prompts_v1.jsonl
- Required: hash user_id (SHA-256 ok), keep "geo" and "channel" fields intact, include a short "scenario" label if available.

I attached a basic load test plan (load_plan_v1.xlsx) that we’ll use to run the sanity + ramp sequence during the session. If anything in the plan looks off, flag it before the workshop.

Attachments: load_plan_v1.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExample

See you Wed — we'll allocate a pair of Redwood engineers to observe routing and KV cache behavior while the test runs.

Best,
Monica

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-03T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on workshop, redaction & load test plan

Looping in a couple of operational notes for the workshop:

Routing + prompt review:
- We'll exercise two routing policies: low-latency (small model variant) and cost-saver (quantized variant). Please include a "preferred_model" field if you have model affinity.
- For prompt review, include expected output examples to help us measure regression and hallucination rates.

Load test specifics:
- We'll do: Sanity burst -> steady-state at 5k req/hr -> 30-min ramp to 30k req/hr if you want. For today's scope we will stop at 5k req/hr as requested.
- Provide expected token lengths; we need a token-length distribution to estimate concurrency impact.

Data redaction / fields (must-haves):
- Keep: session_id (masked), geo, channel, prompt_text, scenario.
- Remove or hash: user_id (hash preferred), email, phone_number, credit_card.

If you prefer, we can run a short redaction script on our side given a test file — send one encrypted file and we’ll return a redacted sample.

Feel free to DM if you want us to tweak the load_plan spreadsheet before Wed.

Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
